summary: Published a universal signed and notarized DMG from source commit 876c765b. It adds TIDRADIO TD-H9 Normal, HAM, and GMRS profiles on the TD-H8 G4 transport, matches TK-863G OEM memory-session timing, improves UV-5R Mini echo and handshake recovery, preserves the selected zone during list replacement, and includes the cumulative 1.0.70 UI, driver, bridge, Android USB, trace, printing, and write-progress changes. The bridge now reuses loaded NewChirp driver modules for the same file path instead of re-registering duplicate classes. Artifact SHA-256: cb0bc91f4c1268cd13859170ca329e08c8ba65c606840d68c6541538e8b2ae8b. Apple notarization: 11a7e4f4-f0b4-4bec-bffa-e89561f2a606. The DMG launched from the mounted image; local/server/public hashes matched and the live manifest reports macOS 1.0.71.
title: macOS 1.0.71 published
